shopflow.title: ShopFlow
shopflow.description: A comprehensive e-commerce platform with real-time inventory management, advanced analytics dashboard, and seamless payment integration for modern online retailers.
shopflow.challenge: The client needed to replace a legacy monolithic system that couldn't handle peak traffic spikes during sales events, causing revenue loss and poor user experience.
shopflow.solution: We built a microservices-based architecture with React on the frontend and a Node.js/PostgreSQL backend, integrating Stripe for payments and a real-time WebSocket inventory system.

estatehub.title: EstateHub
estatehub.description: A high-performance real estate listing platform featuring interactive maps, virtual tours, and an intelligent property matching algorithm for buyers and agents.
estatehub.challenge: Real estate agents needed a platform that could surface the right properties to buyers quickly, reducing time-to-match from weeks to days.
estatehub.solution: We leveraged Next.js with Supabase for a blazing-fast SSR experience, built an AI matching engine, and integrated Mapbox for interactive property map search.

datapulse.title: DataPulse
datapulse.description: An enterprise-grade SaaS analytics dashboard providing real-time business intelligence, custom report generation, and predictive insights powered by machine learning.
datapulse.challenge: The client's data team was spending 40% of their time manually generating reports from disparate data sources, slowing down business decisions.
datapulse.solution: We built a Python-powered data pipeline on AWS with a React dashboard. ML models were integrated for anomaly detection and revenue forecasting, all accessible in one unified UI.

feastapp.title: FeastApp
feastapp.description: A cross-platform food delivery application with real-time order tracking, restaurant management tools, and a loyalty rewards system for frequent customers.
feastapp.challenge: The client wanted to enter the competitive food delivery market with a differentiated product — one that prioritized restaurant partner success, not just consumer experience.
feastapp.solution: We created a React Native app with Firebase for real-time GPS tracking and a dedicated restaurant dashboard with analytics, order management, and promotions tools.

fittrack.title: FitTrack Pro
fittrack.description: A fitness tracking platform with personalized workout plans, progress analytics, social challenges, and integration with popular wearable devices.
fittrack.challenge: Fitness apps often fail due to lack of engagement. The client needed a platform that would keep users motivated through the first 30 days — their biggest churn window.
fittrack.solution: We built social challenge features, AI-driven adaptive workout plans, and deep integrations with Apple Health, Garmin, and Fitbit using Vue.js and a Node.js backend.

newswire.title: NewsWire
newswire.description: A modern digital news platform with dynamic content management, real-time updates, personalized feeds, and optimized for high-traffic editorial operations.
newswire.challenge: A major media group needed to migrate from a slow, inflexible CMS to a modern platform that could handle breaking news at scale without performance degradation.
newswire.solution: We built a Next.js platform with GraphQL and Redis caching to handle millions of concurrent readers. A custom CMS was designed for editorial speed, with personalized feeds driven by user behavior.
